_comment: The three model files image generation loads (since 2.6.6 FLUX.2 [klein] 4B), pinned to a Hugging Face revision and checked by size and SHA-256 (scripts/fetch_image_models.py). All three are ungated (Apache-2.0). The VAE must be the full-encoder file: sd-server refuses the small decoder on its own. The text encoder is not listed twice: 'from_app_models' names the CPU pool tier in scripts/app_models.json whose url, sha256 and size are used. engine/image_member.py MODEL_FILES holds the names and sizes the coordinator checks at run time; tests/test_image_packaging.py keeps the two in step.
